newsitem.title: USA: Calif. state to receive $252 mln reimbursement-Gov.
newsitem.headline: Calif. state to receive $252 mln reimbursement-Gov.

text.p: The state of California will receive $252 million in federal funding as reimbursement for a portion of the cost of incarcerating illegal alien felons, Gov. Pete Wilson said on Thursday.
In addition, California counties will receive $18 million, Wilson said.

Wilson issued his statement about the funds after the Clinton administration announced that it would release $500 million in federal funding earmarked to reimburse states for incarcerating these felons.
"Today's decision by President Clinton to finally release these funds to states like California that have been hard hit by the crisis of illegal immigration is long overdue," Wilson said.
In fiscal year 1996, California taxpayers will pay $511 million to incarcerate nearly 20,000 criminal aliens, Wilson said.
